question: What is the primary operational focus of the team nursing model?

options.A: Rotating nursing personnel randomly across different hospital wards daily
options.B: Assigning one single nurse to manage every aspect of a single patient's shift
options.C: Leaving all clinical decisions entirely up to unregulated nursing assistants
options.D: Delivering collaborative care through a hierarchical group led by a professional nurse

explanation: Team nursing specifically relies on a structured group of diverse healthcare personnel working together under the direction of a registered team leader. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h1)

question: Who holds the ultimate legal accountability for the comprehensive care of patients assigned to a nursing team?
explanation: The team leader takes charge of overall patient outcomes and care planning, even though direct tasks are shared among various team members based on their qualifications. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h1)

question: What is a major objective of implementing the team nursing care model?

options.A: Reducing the total number of patients admitted to healthcare facilities
options.B: Eliminating the need for registered nurses completely in hospital wards
options.C: Ensuring that nursing assistants perform all complex medication administration
options.D: Optimizing available human resources to improve patient safety

explanation: Team nursing strives to make the best use of varied skill mixes to safeguard patient well-being while managing heavy workloads. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h2)

question: How does team nursing align tasks with staff capabilities?

options.A: By matching task complexity to the specific legal and educational scope of each worker
options.B: By rotating all clinical duties randomly among every staff member regardless of training
options.C: By assigning the most difficult procedures exclusively to entry-level nursing students
options.D: By letting workers choose whichever tasks they prefer at the start of the shift

explanation: Efficiency and safety are maintained when high-level clinical judgments are reserved for professional nurses while supportive tasks are handled by auxiliary staff. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h2)

question: Which duty is primarily the responsibility of the registered nurse team leader?

options.A: Conducting comprehensive initial patient assessments and care planning
options.B: Ordering diagnostic laboratory investigations directly from the hospital laboratory
options.C: Exclusively performing bed baths and general hygiene care for all patients
options.D: Discharging patients from the hospital facility without medical clearance

explanation: Initial assessments and individualized care planning require the advanced clinical judgment possessed by a registered nurse team leader. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h3)

question: A nursing assistant reports that a patient's postoperative wound dressing is soaked with fresh bright red blood. What is the most appropriate next step within a team nursing structure?

options.A: The observation should be documented in the chart at the end of the shift
options.B: Another nursing assistant should be sent to check on the patient later
options.C: The nursing assistant should change the dressing independently right away
options.D: The team leader must be notified immediately to assess the surgical site

explanation: Support workers must report clinical abnormalities instantly to the professional team leader, who holds the responsibility for evaluating acute changes. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h3)

question: What is the primary purpose of holding a daily team nursing conference?

options.A: To allow hospital administrators to inspect the cleanliness of the ward
options.B: To conduct annual performance appraisals and disciplinary reviews for staff
options.C: To replace formal patient medical records with verbal storytelling sessions
options.D: To review patient statuses, delegate shift tasks, and discuss care coordination

explanation: The daily conference aligns all team members regarding patient goals, current clinical conditions, and specific task assignments for the upcoming shift. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h4)

question: What is the main risk when communication breaks down within a team nursing structure?

options.A: Fragmentation of care and missed clinical observations
options.B: Immediate automatic promotion of all nursing assistants
options.C: An increase in the total number of hospital beds available
options.D: The complete elimination of physicians from the hospital ward

explanation: Because care responsibilities are divided among different people, poor communication easily leads to overlooked patient needs and fragmented interventions. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h4)

question: Which of the following is a recognized advantage of the team nursing model?

options.A: Complete elimination of all communication errors in the hospital
options.B: Guaranteed single-room accommodation for every admitted patient
options.C: Removal of any need for professional supervision of support staff
options.D: Efficient utilization of varied skill mixes and staff capabilities

explanation: Team nursing allows healthcare institutions to maximize workforce efficiency by deploying staff according to their training levels. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h5)

question: What is a frequent patient complaint associated with team nursing?

options.A: Frustration over having to perform their own physical assessments
options.B: Confusion resulting from interacting with multiple different caregivers
options.C: Annoyance that doctors never visit patients in this care model
options.D: Feeling neglected because only one nurse visits them all week

explanation: Because tasks are divided among several team members, patients often cannot identify who their primary nurse is, leading to fragmented interpersonal experiences. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h5)

question: How does functional nursing differ fundamentally from team nursing?

options.A: Functional nursing relies exclusively on daily team conferences for task delegation
options.B: Functional nursing gives one registered nurse total 24-hour accountability for a single client
options.C: Functional nursing completely bans the use of nursing assistants in clinical settings
options.D: Functional nursing assigns specific tasks like medication or dressings to specific workers across the whole ward

explanation: Functional nursing is task-oriented rather than patient-oriented, meaning staff perform single functions for every patient on the ward. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h6)

question: Which care model features a single registered nurse maintaining 24-hour responsibility for a patient's plan of care throughout their hospital stay?
explanation: Primary nursing establishes a one-to-one relationship of accountability where one nurse oversees the client's journey from admission to discharge. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h6)

question: What is a major systemic challenge when implementing team nursing in resource-constrained Nigerian clinical environments?

options.A: Excessive funding that leads to administrative confusion
options.B: A total absence of any auxiliary healthcare support workers
options.C: Patients refusing to be cared for by registered nurses
options.D: High patient-to-nurse ratios and severe staffing shortages

explanation: Overstretched workloads in public healthcare facilities can dilute the effectiveness of team coordination and rush daily conferences. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h7)

question: A newly appointed ward manager in a Nigerian hospital wants to reduce friction between registered nurses and support staff in a team nursing setup. Which strategy should be prioritized?

options.A: Prohibiting nursing assistants from speaking during any shift handovers
options.B: Assigning all administrative paperwork exclusively to junior support staff
options.C: Conducting workshops on legal scopes of practice, delegation, and mutual respect
options.D: Eliminating team conferences to save time during busy morning shifts

explanation: Clarifying roles, safe delegation boundaries, and fostering professional respect helps resolve hierarchical friction and improves teamwork. [learn more](GNS123_U1_T4#GNS123_U1_T4_h7)
